samples.name: aiyou_litellm
samples.purpose: LLM gateway/proxy with optional Rust acceleration
review: Python initialization and proxy/provider configuration; native bridge loaders and authorization entry points
ARM64 ELF imports, exports, strings and PyO3 module-registration disassembly
Pinned sdist Rust bridge registration, provider auth and caller-selected HTTP routes; native credential/process imports consistent with cloud SDK credential chains
limitations: Python/source correspondence does not establish a reproducible build of the native binary.

samples.name: keyboard
samples.purpose: Global keyboard/mouse hooks and input simulation
review: Platform implementations, listener startup and CLI JSON stdin/stdout event interface
Linux /dev/input and /dev/uinput, Windows SetWindowsHookEx and SendInput
No network upload, hidden startup or credential collection found; VirtualBox reference explains an input-device path edge case.

samples.name: memoryos
samples.purpose: Configurable memory system for LLM applications
review: Initialization, CLI entry points, API client, scheduler, plugin loading and storage adapters
Requested example download and optional CUSTOM_LOGGER_URL logging, rather than unexplained download/execution
Local pickle deserialization is a noteworthy unsafe-input capability, without evidence of a malicious payload in this artifact.

samples.name: upgini
samples.purpose: External feature search/enrichment and model comparison client
review: Substantive feature enrichment, dataset upload and model comparison implementation; service usefulness was not benchmarked
tracking.json accompanies service calls; default backend is https://search.upgini.com
Tracks IDE, hostname and username; ordinary environments add public IP and SHA256 of uuid.getnode(), usually derived from a MAC address
Colab dynamically imports https://upgini.github.io/upgini/js/a.js and uses FingerprintJS visitor identity

Kaggle session token is used only with Kaggle secret-store RPC; an error response is parsed for a numeric visitor identifier, without reading the returned secret or sending the session token to Upgini
Default remote logging includes tracking; logs_enabled=False does not disable tracking attached to dataset requests

disclosure.upfront: Bundled README does not explain hostname/username collection, MAC-derived ID, remote fingerprinting or the Kaggle identifier lookup.
disclosure.policy: Current privacy policy broadly describes device, technical and tracking data; it does not explain these SDK mechanisms.

samples.intent_assessment: More likely benign commercial software with intrusive, poorly disclosed tracking than a hostile package. Retain the suspicious remote-module-loading finding.
limitations: Current remote script is mutable and cannot attest what the URL served historically.
No service request, package installation or specimen execution was performed.
